description: This file defines a routing component for a documentation chatbot, specifically implementing a query planning endpoint using an agent router in an asynchronous context. It creates a router with a prefix, defines an async function to generate diverse search queries based on user questions, and uses specific context and strategies to formulate search intents.

classes.name: AgentRouter
classes.description: A router class from agentfield used to define API endpoints related to agent-based reasoning and AI functionalities.

methods.name: QueryPlan plan_queries(question: str)
methods.description: An asynchronous function that generates 3-5 diverse search queries based on the user's question, leveraging the agent router's AI capabilities and context.
